card.name: Before pharmacokinetics in interaction findings
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or the end of a drug name) right after verbs like affect, alter, impact or decrease, just before a pharmacokinetic term such as pharmacokinetics, absorption or exposure. It appears in drug-interaction study summaries.

modes.label: "the" after effect verb
modes.description: The article follows "did not affect/alter/impact" or "decreased" and is followed by a pharmacokinetic term.
modes.example: did not affect<< the>> pharmacokinetics of norethind

modes.label: End of drug name
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name is the object of an interaction, before pharmacokinetics or plasma concentrations.
modes.example: nifedipine had no effect on irbesart<<an>> pharmacokinetics

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug-interaction sentence where the text is about to name what a drug did or did not change, such as pharmacokinetics.
